references.text: The Nazirite shall be holy to the Lord all the days of his separation, just as his hair must not be cut.
The priests were to be holy to their God, in the same way that the Nazirite is holy to the Lord.
Samson was to be a Nazirite to God from birth, an example of dedication to the Lord.
The child shall be a Nazirite to God from birth until the day of his death.
Hannah vowed that Samuel would be dedicated to the Lord all the days of his life.
The Nazirites were raised up by God as holy persons, but Israel caused them to break their vow.
Believers are urged to present their bodies as a living, holy sacrifice to God.
